# Saudi Financial Services: Understanding the Regulatory Perimeter of SAMA and the CMA
## Why this matters now
SAMA continues to license payment service providers, open banking providers, finance companies and buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) businesses.

## SAMA and the financial services perimeter
Saudi Arabia has moved strongly toward electronic payments, and SAMA continues to license and supervise payment service providers and payment-related fintech businesses.

SAMA has moved beyond sandbox testing and has begun licensing fintech companies to provide open banking services.

## Where the regulatory analysis becomes more complex
3. Fintech companies using open banking, account data, payment initiation or bank integrations need to assess whether they require SAMA licensing or can operate through an appropriately licensed Saudi partner.
